claim: Patchline ships a governance succession plan proving bus-factor resilience with documented term limits. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the bus-factor claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make governance-succession-plan-gate`.
